meta.title: EIDOS — Every idea has a shape
meta.description: Give Claude a PDF, a photo of a whiteboard or a question; get back a world you can scroll through, verify, and that grows with you.

landing.m1: Give Claude a PDF, a photo of your whiteboard or a question. You get back a world you can walk through.
landing.m2: Claude reads your sources like an expert.
landing.m2b: Every claim stays anchored to the page it comes from.
landing.m3: It designs the journey the way your best teacher would: a hook, an intuition, the mechanism, the common mistake and a question to check you really understood.
landing.m4: And if you get it wrong, the world grows a new chapter, just for you.
landing.m5: What do you want to understand today?
landing.samplePassage: Every fact in the ledger points to an exact passage of your source. If something isn't there, EIDOS says so.
landing.footer: Built with Claude · EIDOS is an educational prototype.
